#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Sydney Fortner] (Role not specified, UCSB) – [October 16, 2024, 1:53 AM]:**
  - Reported an issue with autocorrect being disabled in the app despite user settings.
  - Requested a fix for the autocorrect feature.
  - *Key quote:* "Currently, autocorrect is disabled in the app, despite users having the setting turned on. A fix would be lovely-- thank you!"

- **[Sara Farnya] (Role not specified, UCSB) – [October 16, 2024, after 1:53 AM]:**
  - Requested to CC Nadezhda Barbashova and Mengsi Li on the issue.

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Tech Support, Avicenna Research) – [October 16, 2024, 1:53 AM]:**
  - Acknowledged the autocorrect issue and apologized for the inconvenience.
  - Promised a fix to be deployed by October 23rd.
  - Provided escalation link for unresolved issues.
  - *Key quote:* "That is indeed an issue on our side, we will work on a fix and you can expect the fix to be deployed by the upcoming Wednesday (Oct. 23rd)."

- **[Sydney Fortner] (Role not specified, UCSB) – [October 16, 2024, after 1:53 AM]:**
  - Thanked Amin for addressing the issue and requested updates on the resolution.

- **[Sara Farnya] (Role not specified, UCSB) – [October 17, 2024, before 2:28 AM]:**
  - Asked if a task had been created for the issue and mentioned not facing the issue personally.

  - Later noted that the task was found (ET-10035).

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Tech Support, Avicenna Research) – [October 17, 2024, 2:28 AM]:**

  - Advised participants to update their application for the fix to take effect.
  - *Key quote:* "the autocorrect issue had been resolved and the new update containing the fix is being rolled out."
